# GitHub Social Preview — VON

**语言中立：** tagline 与 prompt 不得出现编程语言名、logo、后缀或典型语法片段。

File: [`social-preview.jpg`](./social-preview.jpg) — **1280×640**, target &lt; 500 KB (must be **&lt; 1 MB**).

## Upload

1. [Settings → Social preview](https://github.com/voml/von-language/settings#social-preview)
2. Upload **`.github/social-preview.jpg`**

## Layout brief

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Size | 1280×640 (2:1，GenerateImage 后 cover 裁切) |
| Tagline | Human-readable data with clear structure |
| Primary | `#0EA5E9` sky blue |
| Energy | `#F59E0B` amber |
| Background | mist paper `#F3F6F1` |
| Mood | light editorial, calm, human-readable |

**构图：** 左文右图。右侧 3～4 张侧向错开的 config 页，天蓝描边，amber 锚点，柔和阴影。

## Image prompt (English)

```
Ultra-wide banner, central 89% safe zone for 2:1 crop. Light editorial poster, mist paper #F3F6F1.

LEFT: "VON", "Human-readable data with clear structure".

RIGHT: staggered stack of config document sheets, sky blue #0EA5E9 outlines, amber #F59E0B anchor dots, soft shadows, Swiss calm layout, one focal stack.

No programming language names or logos.
```
